scenes.say: Ever wonder why teams push testing earlier in the workflow? What does shift-left really mean for your code?

scenes.label: Shift-Left
scenes.sub: Move testing to earlier stages of development.
scenes.say: Shift-left means running tests sooner, not just at the end. We build quality in from the start.

scenes.title: Automated Tests on Pull Requests
scenes.say: With continuous integration, every pull request kicks off automated tests. Tools like Jenkins or GitHub Actions catch issues before code merges.
Testing late means bugs slip through. Shift-left finds issues fast, so fixes are easier and less expensive.

scenes.question: Is manual testing enough in CI?
scenes.wrong: Yes, manual testing covers all cases.
scenes.right: No, automated tests in CI catch issues early and speed up feedback.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: is manual testing enough in continuous integration? Nope. Automated tests in CI are key to catching problems early.
